note.zh-TW: IAS 1 沒有定義這個小計；IFRS 18 新增的 operating profit or loss 範圍較廣，不完全相同。
note.en: IAS 1 does not define this subtotal; the operating profit or loss introduced by IFRS 18 is broader and not identical.

definition.zh-TW: 營業毛利再減掉銷管費用後的結果，是五層利益的第二層。它代表本業賺了多少，還沒算利息、業外收支與所得稅。
definition.en: Gross profit less distribution and administrative expenses, the second of the five profit levels. It shows what the core business earned before interest, non-operating items and tax.
